mostWorthwhile.text: Measuring both radio loads against usable capacity and starting charge was most worthwhile: it made the overnight reserve claim concrete, with a margin and a follow-up check.

leastWorthwhile.text: My attempted load measurement was the least worthwhile moment: it failed without explaining which prerequisite was missing.

surprise.text: The meter could not be used on the mounted radios until the reserves and local route were configured; the solar panels also would not add energy overnight.

arbitrary.text: Requiring the local route to be configured before measuring the radios' load felt somewhat arbitrary; the result did not explain why that order was necessary.

continue.text: Yes. I'd like to see how the neighborhoods make their networks understand each other, and the measured, practical repair made this chapter engaging.
